# Tidy

TIDY helps to maintain a clean house. A rental. Your employee's workspace. Your home. All automated through TIDY.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tidy/.

## Actions

- **Create Address**: Create a new address record with location data, parking information, and access instructions.
- **Delete Address**: Remove an address from the system by its unique identifier.
- **List All Addresses** (read-only): Retrieve all addresses sorted by creation date with most recent first.
- **List All Jobs** (read-only): Retrieve all jobs associated with an account with optional filtering by address_id, status, or to_do_list_id.
- **List Available Booking Time Slots** (read-only): Retrieve available booking time slots from professionals in your network for the next 4 weeks.
- **List Guest Reservations** (read-only): Retrieve all guest reservations sorted by creation date with most recent first.
- **List To-Do Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all active address to-do lists with optional filtering by address_id, sorted by creation date with most recent first.
- **Retrieve Address** (read-only): Retrieve the details of an existing address by its unique identifier.
- **Update Address**: Update parking details and access notes for an existing address.
- **Create Pro**: Add a Pro to the Priority List for all addresses in a customer account.
